defects: Uses `LinearMap.det`, which in Mathlib is only defined for endomorphisms `M →ₗ[R] M` (same source and target type); here `f : E →ₗᵢ[𝕜] F` with E and F distinct general types, so `LinearMap.det (f : E →ₗ[𝕜] F)` does not typecheck

Replaces the gold's purpose-built `LinearMap.normDet` (generalized norm-determinant for maps between possibly different-dimensional inner product spaces, defined via orthonormal bases) with an attempt to reconstruct it via `‖LinearMap.det ...‖`, which is not mathematically equivalent and not even well-typed for non-endomorphisms
Adds an extra hypothesis `[FiniteDimensional 𝕜 F]` (codomain finite-dimensional) that is not present in the gold, which only requires the domain U to be finite-dimensional

Uses `[NormedField 𝕜]` instead of `[RCLike 𝕜]`; since `InnerProductSpace 𝕜 E` itself requires an `RCLike 𝕜` instance argument, declaring only `NormedField 𝕜` is insufficient/inconsistent with the rest of the hypotheses
Redundant explicit `[NormedSpace 𝕜 E]`/`[NormedSpace 𝕜 F]` hypotheses alongside `InnerProductSpace`, which already extends `NormedSpace`
